What I do

Practical document control that keeps engineering, procurement and construction teams working from the right revision.

01

Document registers

Revision control, classification, transmittals and archiving, set up so anyone can find the current version in seconds.

02

Submittals and RFIs

Tracking logs with overdue flags and status reports, so open items never sit unnoticed.

03

Test pack supervision

Dividing systems into test packs and loops, compiling packs from P&IDs and isometrics, coordinating Engineering, Construction and QC, and tracking punch items through to closure.

04

Excel automation

PivotTables, Power Query and macros that replace hours of manual reporting.

05

Power BI dashboards

Clear weekly dashboards for management: progress, backlog and aging at a glance.

06

Data cleanup

Python and pandas scripts to clean, merge and reconcile messy document and transmittal lists.

EPC and construction projects. 3+ years as Test Pack Supervisor and Document Control Specialist on a large EPC project in Egypt, handling more than 5,600 test packs with weekly management reporting.

Which languages and time zone?

English and Arabic. I am based in Egypt (UTC+2), which overlaps well with Europe and the Gulf.
